328fec0.summary: Resolves a Mob action: if the acting card is still in play (or dying) its Mob ability is triggered with AbilityTrigger.Mob (and a Mob event is broadcast unless it is an additional Mob trigger), then the shared end-of-action logic runs. That logic reassembles minion positions, ends the battle if a hero is dead (sending match finished to the opponent and saving results), and refreshes turn UI and hero/minion activation. Called when a Mob action is dequeued.
comments: Only fire the Mob ability if the card is still in play or dying (not already gone)
Remember the action type; below, minion reordering is skipped for reorder actions
Queue is empty: if either side's minions are out of position, queue a reassemble order
No automatic actions pending: this is the point where the action chain is fully done
Outside tutorial/campaign matches, check whether either hero is dead (waitingToDie, state 5)
Hero is dead: build and log a debug string about the battle state (decompiler spells out the concat)
Already in post-battle: only continue if the disconnect-loss flag is set, else warn and bail out
Opponent disconnected flag set: record a loss for the enemy and run the basic battle end sequence
Normal end: enter post-battle, stop the battle and tell the other player the match finished (if networked)
Lock the UI into the finish-battle state and clear the during-battle flag
Player won: raise an enemy-health-change signal using the enemy hero's current health
Get the Elo rating: from the leaderboard event if there is one, else from the player's stored rating
Work out the winner and build the ranked match result with Elo and XP
Fill in the skull milestones for both sides (player's own, and the enemy's based on the player hero's health)
Win in certain match types (0x14, 0xb4, 0xd2): tell LiveOps the opponent was human
Save the result, then finish the battle; this ends the method
Null-check failure target for the battle-end path
Neither hero is dead: broadcast the while-in-play triggers to refresh state
Action fully resolved: clear the resolving flag
Enemy's turn: activate enemy minions and recompute whether the enemy hero can act or attack
Ferocity/Oath heroes: recompute canAct and switch to an active attack if summon sickness is displayed
Show or hide the hero's can-attack animation object depending on whether it can attack now
Player's turn: highlight playable cards and activate the player's minions and hero
Nothing queued: run a garbage collection while idle and unpause the turn clock
If the player may act and only the end-turn action remains, show the no-actions UI on the clock
Scripted (tutorial/AI scripted) turn: if the script was waiting for a manual player action, continue it
Shared null-check failure target: any null manager above ends up here

3290098.summary: Resolves a Codex trigger on the acting unit and then on every other in-play unit of the same side, broadcasting Codex events, and finishes the action via FinishResolvingAction. Called when a Codex action is dequeued; throws NullReferenceException if anything is null.
comments: Log whose units the codex is being resolved for (the acting unit's side)
Fire the acting unit's own Codex trigger first
If it really has a Codex ability, broadcast the unit Codex event (UI/other listeners)
Loop over every unit in play
Skip the acting unit itself
Only units still in play, and only those on the same side as the acting unit, get the trigger
Trigger Codex on this friendly unit; broadcast if it currently has the codex trait
All units handled: finish the action (turn UI, hero death checks, etc.)
Null-check failure target
